i'm already so behind,
what's even the point of starting now?
(i was behind too)

"i don't even know where to start."

start with the next class.
not the first one you missed.

"it's too late to get a good grade."

maybe. but it's never too late
to get a better one.

"everyone else understands it."

half of them are just as lost.
ask the question.

"i don't have enough time."

thirty minutes a day, every day.
it adds up faster than you think.

"i'm just not a school person."

before, i thought i wasn't curious.
now i learn one new thing every morning. and school feels lighter.
